task: S23 innovation route 3: generation ancestry and reference-group effects
verdict: Accept with Revisions for a bounded conditional problem investigation only; no method validation; no execution approval implied
hypothesis: With the same real anchor, three reference camera slots, and four conditioning frames, same-nonroot-branch groups may give worse anchored revisits than complementary mixed groups, beyond ordinary quality/similarity selection.

scientific_limits: a single unit is not independent confirmation
branches can represent different legitimate world completions
randomized branches are not independent observations of physical truth
metadata-only changes are not the main causal experiment
initial-view error does not measure truth of unobserved regions
independent unseen scenes and preregistered stopping/uncertainty criteria required

no actual generated-reference exposure => no tested setting
ordinary quality or similarity suffices => no independent ancestry novelty
no stable improvement or worse complementary mixtures => reject benefit claim or report uncertainty per frozen criteria
